title: Tenma Saki — Peeking Around The Partition〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm all set to go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm also ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's have another fun practice today and—

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, I think your phone's ringing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's my boss!
Sorry, I need to take this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hi, boss. Tenma here.
Yes... Yes, that's fine...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why do you think her manager's calling her...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This could be about them doing that shoot for TV. Saki's scheduled to work that day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot.
That shoot's fairly soon, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not only that, Haruka and the others will be there too—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
O-Okay, I understand.
I'll also try asking around...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone, please answer this as honestly as you can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How would you like some extra money...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: ...which is why this person with a ton of experience won't be able to make it that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we urgently need someone to fill in now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What about any of the other employees at the cafe?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, my boss did manage to find someone who can come in that day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But they won't be able to make up for years of experience. Which is why we still need one more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, what does this job involve...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... You'd be waiting tables and putting on the finishing touches to sweets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Like decorating them...?
In that case...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How about it, Hona...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As much as I want to help, I unfortunately have a prior engagement...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you honestly think I can wait tables?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, how did you...?! And don't give me that look!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't want to get your hopes up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, Ichika seems like the best person for this job.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I probably wouldn't have too much trouble waiting tables, but I'm less sure about decorating sweets...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, wait!
Ichi, you know how to make hamburgers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That just basically involves stacking things together. Anyone can do it as long as you follow the instructions...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're talking about parfaits and stuff, right? I really don't know if I'll be able to decorate them properly. Even just putting on dollops of fresh whipped cream might be...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't worry! I was also really terrible at first! This one time, my dollops of whipped cream all turned into cream-shaped ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Please, Ichi...!
You're my only hope!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And you'll get paid!
You can buy whatever clothes or delicious food you like!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The money does sound nice...
But I still feel that I won't be all that helpful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Just waiting tables alone would be huge!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please...! I seriously don't have anyone else that I can turn to!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Think of it as helping me and the cafe...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll help if you can't find anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I really don't think I'm cut out for decorating sweets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, how about I take over the decorating?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling you'd be very good at that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ichi, Shiho!
I love you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't forget the part about looking for someone else first, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
Hehe...!
